subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “On hot summer days, people in Maple City usually walk on the east side of Green Road.”?
options: After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.
Visitors can go there after reading, but they must stay on the paths.
After reading the report, the city office decided to plant more trees on the west side of the road.
The class planted small trees along a section of the river with permission from the city.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Visitors can go there after reading, but they must stay on the paths.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「After reading the report, the city office decided to plant more trees on the west side of the road.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The class planted small trees along a section of the river with permission from the city.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
